bio: A true nerd at heart, a father of two wonderful kids that lives in central Texas.  I love the outdoors just as much as I love sitting in my digital cave coding or playing video games.  I'm an analytical thinker that loves to understand how things are put together and work from a logical view.

hobbies.name: Fishing
hobbies.detail: I love all kinds of fishing, from catching largemouth bass in local Texas waterways to catching giant tuna offshore, none of it is off limits for me.

hobbies.name: Gaming
hobbies.detail: I've been a gamer most of my life, from starting on Sega and NES as a kid to now playing PC games like Valorant and Hearthstone.

funFacts: Has caught a 100+ LB yellowfin tuna
Has squared up against Eddie Jones from the Lakers on a basketball court
Tried out for the Nickelodeon show 'All That'
values: Karma is real in some form or another
Vibing at work - it should be fun
Love is the answer to most problems
workingStyle: Prefers writing a design doc before a big change
Majority of all meetings should be an hour or less
Slack is one of the best tools in modern day workflows
I like work that is decided on and has a cadence to getting done i.e 2 week sprints with a commitment to what has been planned.
Break larger problems into smaller ones

voice.tone: Friendly, direct, a little nerdy humor, never corporate, sometimes cynical, mocks ridiculousness
